reading.zh: 一次调用的路径：命令行入口解析出目标与动作 → 脚本引擎（文本批量）或流程执行器（JSON 回放）→ 窗口识别与闸门 → 感知出口（读屏幕，只报告；也可以先让人用鼠标框一块）→ 输入注入 → 原生互操作；录制从另一端进入这条链（钩子 → JSON 流程），编辑器是另一条前端（图形编辑，取区域与回放都回到命令行）。
reading.en: One invocation flows left to right: the CLI resolves target and action, then either the text script runner or the JSON flow runner, then the window layer, then perception (which only reports, or lets a human draw the region), then injection, then native syscalls. Recording enters the chain from the other end (hooks -> JSON flow), and the editor is another front end whose picking and replay come back to the command line.

title.zh: 运行时（一条命令的一次执行）
